blocks.source: 【音楽室】没曲その２
blocks.translation: [Music Room] Unused Track #2

blocks.source: 没曲その２です。
blocks.translation: This is Unused Track #2.

blocks.source: フリー素材としても使えますが、品質は保証しません。なんせ没ですので。転載するも魔改造するも自由です。
blocks.translation: You may also use it as a free asset, but I make no guarantees about its quality. After all, it was rejected. Feel free to repost it or radically modify it.

blocks.source: 一括ダウンロードのzipにはmidiファイルも含まれています。
blocks.translation: The bulk-download ZIP also includes MIDI files.

blocks.source: NR_boss10.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_boss10.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 格好いいボス戦を作ろうと思った挙句、迷走してしまったようです。とりあえずピアノ入れとけみたいな。今までのボス戦曲よりも努力は窺えますが、すげえ使いにくそうな一曲。
blocks.translation: I seem to have lost my way after setting out to create a cool boss battle theme. It feels like I just threw in a piano for the time being. You can hear more effort than in my previous boss battle themes, but this is an extremely difficult track to use.

blocks.source: 無駄に希望あふれるラスボス曲。もうちょっと編曲を頑張れば、化けそうな気もするのですが……。
blocks.translation: A final boss theme overflowing with hope for no particular reason. I feel like it might really come into its own with a little more work on the arrangement...

blocks.source: NR_field10.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field10.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 地味ながら実用レベルに達してはいると思われます。地味に好きです。
blocks.translation: It is understated, but I think it has reached a practical level of usability. I rather like it in a low-key way.

blocks.source: NR_field11.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field11.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: マーチ調のフィールド曲。個人的にフィールド曲はもうちょっと重いほうが好きですが。
blocks.translation: A march-style field theme. Personally, I prefer field themes to be a little heavier, though.

blocks.source: NR_scene2.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_scene2.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 感動的なイベントシーンに使えそう。残念ながら作風に全く合いませんでした。
blocks.translation: It seems like it could work in an emotional event scene. Unfortunately, it did not fit the style at all.

blocks.source: NR_dark4.mp3（☆）
blocks.translation: NR_dark4.mp3 (☆)

blocks.source: 殺人事件発生。ミステリーやホラーなら使えるんじゃないでしょうか。知らんけど。
blocks.translation: A murder has occurred. It might work for a mystery or horror game. Who knows, though.

blocks.source: NR_town4.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_town4.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: やたら爽やか。爽やかすぎて使いにくい。でも嫌いではないです。
blocks.translation: Excessively bright and refreshing. It is too refreshing to be easy to use. But I do not dislike it.

blocks.source: エンディングのエピローグとかに使えればよかったのですが、雰囲気が合わず断念。
blocks.translation: I wish I could have used it for an ending epilogue or something, but I gave up because it did not fit the atmosphere.

blocks.source: NR_village4.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_village4.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 地味ながら安定した村の曲。かなり初期に作ったわりによくできていると思います。本採用してもよかったんですけどね。
blocks.translation: An understated but solid village theme. I think it turned out quite well despite being made very early on. I could have officially adopted it, though.

blocks.source: NR_jpop1.mp3（☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_jpop1.mp3 (☆☆)

blocks.source: ＪＰＯＰの王道進行とやらを知って遊びで作った曲。卒業でもしそうな何か。
blocks.translation: A song I made for fun after learning about the classic J-pop chord progression. Something that sounds like someone might be graduating.
